game_title: Range Check Bridge – Pearl Divers' Lagoon Streak
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Coastal Port – Pearl Divers' Lagoon, a lagoon of pearl divers: the dock cartographer must handle rogue crabs while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Range Check Bridge: Test ranges such as 10 <= weight < 20 to let only the right travelers cross.
theme: Coastal Port – Pearl Divers' Lagoon: a lagoon of pearl divers
core_gameplay_loop: In Pearl Divers' Lagoon, repeat each round: Test ranges such as 10 <= weight < 20 to let only the right travelers cross. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the bridge_load value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 11 consecutive correct decisions about bridge_load to power up the dock cartographer and open the signal flag.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 4 (applied tier): Range Check Bridge
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Range Check Bridge' (Week 3 slot 8), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Pearl Divers' Lagoon'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how bridge_load changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crabs in Pearl Divers' Lagoon.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 11.
